## Team knowledge (Huddle channel "The golden channel")

<!-- exported from Huddle <volatile>: 2 entries -->

### Facts

- **Ports outlive pids**: A saved port is the address; the pid only says who held it once.
- **The golden server binds port zero**: PORT=0 makes the server bind any free port and print the one it got, so a recording never races a fixed one. (see `scripts/record-goldens.ts`; every channel)
